nodes.label: concurrency group bump-<variable>
nodes.rationale: Jobs for the same variable run one at a time, queued and never cancelled, so no bump is lost.

nodes.label: bump-pin inputs (app, host_vars_path, variable, tag, target_repo)
nodes.norm_label: bump-pin inputs (app, host_vars_path, variable, tag, target_repo)

nodes.label: Commit SHA pinning with release comment
nodes.norm_label: commit sha pinning with release comment
nodes.rationale: Callers pin reusable workflows to a full commit SHA with the release tag in a comment so Dependabot keeps both SHA and version current; every uses: must be SHA-pinned.

nodes.label: GitHub App token (app_id, app_private_key)
nodes.rationale: The PR is opened with a GitHub App token so the target repo's CI runs on it (GITHUB_TOKEN-created PRs do not trigger workflows); no fallback to GITHUB_TOKEN, and secrets are passed explicitly instead of secrets: inherit.

nodes.label: Job names are part of the interface
nodes.norm_label: job names are part of the interface
nodes.rationale: Rulesets require checks by job name (security-baseline / workflow-lint etc., and bump), so renaming a job breaks required checks and is a major version.

nodes.label: Scanner binaries pinned by version and SHA-256
nodes.norm_label: scanner binaries pinned by version and sha-256
nodes.rationale: Dependabot does not bump scanner binaries downloaded inside the workflow, so version and checksum must be updated together manually.

nodes.label: Closing older bump/<variable>-* PRs
nodes.rationale: Only older-tag bump PRs are closed; newer ones and branches with unparseable tags are left alone.

nodes.label: Idempotent re-run completes half-finished bumps
nodes.rationale: A re-run adds a missing PR or auto-merge and cleans up an older open PR even when the pin is already on main; merged or auto-merge-enabled PRs end green without changes.

nodes.label: Upward-only pin with semver validation
nodes.rationale: The pin only moves upward: an older tag is skipped, a pre-release tag or equal value ends green with no change, and a tag or pin not in vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH form fails the job.
